requirements.title: Design and Development
requirements.description: Collaborate with product managers and other developers to analyze user needs and design, build, and deploy new software programs and features.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in designing and developing scalable business intelligence applications, as demonstrated in the Business Intelligence Dashboard project.

requirements.title: Coding
requirements.description: Write clean, scalable, and efficient code using established development practices and conventions.
requirements.explanation: The candidate's experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks like React.js, Python, and Flask suggests proficiency in writing clean and efficient code.

requirements.title: Testing and Debugging
requirements.description: Conduct unit and integration testing and perform debugging to ensure strong functionality, optimal performance, and security.
requirements.explanation: The candidate mentions an analytical mindset for debugging and performance optimization, which aligns with the requirement for testing and debugging skills.

requirements.title: Maintenance and Improvement
requirements.description: Maintain and improve the performance of existing software.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in maintaining and improving software, as evidenced by the Data Visualization Upgrade project.

wishes.title: Collaboration Skills
wishes.description: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
wishes.explanation: The candidate describes a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams, although specific examples of teamwork in diverse groups are limited.

wishes.title: Passion for Learning
wishes.description: Passion for learning and writing about tech.
wishes.explanation: The candidate expresses a passion for learning and has written LinkedIn articles about tech, indicating engagement with ongoing education and community sharing.
